profileSource: Dashi dist/theme-runtime/bespoke-profiles.module.mjs plus source CSS/component artifacts when present.

fontMapping.policy: Preserve original Dashi font stacks as evidence; the template runtime maps mono to Consolas, serif to SimSun, and sans-serif to Microsoft YaHei using system fonts. Review the actual Office visual because available fonts vary by system.

sharedGridNote: Profile pad/gap values are exact source CSS pixels. A single column count is not declared at theme level; use each selected page structureFingerprint for composition.
